label: Galleri sensitivity (upper GI)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | prevalent upper GI cancer)
source: PATHFINDER 2 episode sensitivity for 12 deadly cancers 69.8% x CSO accuracy 91.3% (GRAIL 2026); range CCGA3 stage I-II to all-stage (Klein 2021)

label: Galleri E/S signal (other cancer)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | prevalent cancer elsewhere that the workup can find)
source: Overall episode sensitivity 39.3% x CSO error 8.7% (PATHFINDER 2) x assumed 20% of wrong CSOs called E/S

label: Galleri false-positive rate (E/S)
description: P(Galleri +ve with esophagus/stomach signal | no cancer)
source: False-positive rate 0.36% (PATHFINDER 2 specificity 99.64%) x assumed 10% with an E/S CSO

label: EGD sensitivity
description: EGD sensitivity for prevalent upper GI cancer
source: 1 - 11.3% upper GI cancers missed at EGD within 3 years (Menon & Trudgill 2014)

label: P(EGD +ve)
description: EGD finds an upper GI cancer among Galleri +ve with an esophagus/stomach signal
source: Derived: stomach/esophagus CSO PPV 64.6% (NHS-Galleri; Neal 2026) x CSO1 accuracy 87% (real-world; Matrana 2025) x EGD sensitivity 88.7% (Menon 2014)

label: P(routed to ENT)
description: EGD -ve patients routed to ENT evaluation (rest go to PET CT)
source: No published data: a local pathway choice. Set from your protocol or counts.csv

label: P(ENT +ve)
description: ENT evaluation +ve
source: No published rate for head and neck cancer behind an E/S signal (case series only: Talwar 2026). Wide uncertainty

label: P(PET pancreatobiliary +ve)
description: PET CT pancreatobiliary finding (PET -ve is the remainder of the group)
source: Anchored on PATHFINDER 2: PET/CT after a negative targeted workup found cancer in 7/63 (11.1%); half assumed pancreatobiliary (70% malignant x EUS sensitivity 91%)

label: P(PET incidental +ve)
description: PET CT incidental non-GI/non-pancreatobiliary finding
source: Anchored on PATHFINDER 2 PET/CT yield 11.1%; half assumed from incidental findings that are malignant one-third of the time

label: P(EUS sampling +ve)
description: EUS sampling +ve (no sampling is the remainder of the group)
source: Assumed 70% of PET pancreatobiliary findings malignant x EUS-guided tissue acquisition sensitivity 91% (Dig Dis Sci 2026 meta-analysis)

label: P(EUS sampling -ve)
description: EUS sampling -ve
source: Assumed 90% of EUS include sampling; sampled but negative = 0.90 - 0.64

label: P(missed cancer | -ve workup)
description: Cancer diagnosed within 12 months of a negative workup
source: PATHFINDER 2: 4 of ~117 positives with no cancer at diagnostic resolution were diagnosed with cancer within 12 months (Nabavizadeh 2026)

label: P(cancer | incidental finding)
description: Share of incidental PET +ve findings that are cancer (rest are benign)
source: Incidental FDG PET/CT findings malignant about one-third of the time: thyroid 30.8% (de Leijer 2021 meta-analysis); breast 33.5%; prostate 21.3%

label: P(late | screen-detected)
description: Share of screen-detected cancers that are late stage
source: PATHFINDER 2: 53% of Galleri-detected cancers stage I-II (GRAIL 2026)

label: Odds ratio on SEER late-stage share
description: Multiplies the odds of late stage at symptomatic diagnosis; the base value (1) reproduces SEER stage distribution for each subgroup
source: Stage at symptomatic diagnosis calibrated to SEER 2010-2016 by site, race and sex (CSR Tables 8.8, 24.8); SE assumed for PSA

label: Preclinical sojourn time
description: Mean years an undiagnosed cancer stays preclinical before symptoms (annual presentation = 1 - exp(-1/sojourn))
source: Gastric cancer mean sojourn time 2.37 y (95% CI 1.92-2.96; Bae et al. 2014)

label: Cancer mortality after early dx
description: Annual probability of cancer death after early-stage diagnosis
source: From SEER 5-y relative survival localized (esophagus 48.6%; stomach 78.1%) = 66.1%: 1 - 0.661^(1/5)

label: Cancer mortality after late dx
description: Annual probability of cancer death after late-stage diagnosis
source: From SEER 5-y relative survival regional/distant (stage-weighted) = 18.6%: 1 - 0.186^(1/5)

label: P(perforation | EGD)
description: Perforation per diagnostic upper GI endoscopy (Galleri +ve workup and Kunzmann screening EGDs)
source: ASGE 2012: perforation 1/2,500-1/11,000 diagnostic EGDs (midpoint); Bhatia 2008: 0.03%

label: P(death | EGD perforation)
description: Case fatality of an iatrogenic esophageal perforation; a fatal perforation ends the workup
source: Pooled mortality 9.75% (95% CI 5.9-13.6%), 25 studies, 596 patients with non-surgical iatrogenic perforation (Papaconstantinou 2026); 13.2% for iatrogenic perforation (Biancari 2013)

label: P(serious AE | ENT)
description: Serious adverse event per ENT evaluation (nasolaryngoscopy)
source: Flexible laryngoscopy: serious events very rare; assumed

label: P(serious AE | EUS)
description: Serious adverse event per diagnostic EUS
source: Perforation 0.02-0.06% (ASGE 2022; Forbes)

label: P(serious AE | EUS sampling)
description: Additional serious adverse event risk per EUS sampling (FNA/FNB)
source: Bleeding 0.18% + pancreatitis 0.44% after EUS-FNA (ASGE 2022; Forbes)

label: P(death | other serious AE)
description: Share of non-perforation serious adverse events (ENT, EUS, EUS sampling) that are fatal
source: Assumed

label: PET CT dose (mSv)
description: Effective radiation dose per PET CT
source: PET-CT with low-dose CT 14.0 +/- 1.3 mSv (Quinn 2016); 24.4 mSv with diagnostic CT

label: Cancer risk per Sv
description: Lifetime excess cancer risk per sievert
source: ICRP 103 nominal risk coefficient adults 4.1% per Sv

label: QALY/DALY loss per radiation cancer
description: QALYs (and DALYs) lost per radiation-induced cancer
source: Assumed (radiogenic cancers arise decades later)

label: Days to EGD
description: Days from Galleri result (or risk score) to EGD
source: Assumed; full pathway total consistent with PATHFINDER median 79 days (PATHFINDER 2: 48)

label: Days to ENT
description: Days from previous step to ENT evaluation
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to PET CT
description: Days from previous step to PET CT
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to EUS
description: Days from previous step to EUS
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Days to tumor board
description: Days from previous step to tumor board
source: Assumed (see t_egd)

label: Cost Galleri test
description: Galleri test
source: GRAIL list price $949 (not covered by Medicare)

label: Cost Kunzmann scoring
description: Applying the Kunzmann score (clinician/admin time)
source: Assumed

label: Cost EGD
description: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy
source: Medicare 2024 CPT 43239: OPPS $864.59 + physician $136.48

label: Cost ENT evaluation
description: ENT evaluation (flexible laryngoscopy)
source: Medicare 2026 CPT 31575 non-facility $127.26 (procedure only; excludes office visit)

label: Cost PET CT
description: PET CT
source: Medicare OPPS CPT 78815 $1458.59 (July 2025; facility component)

label: Cost EUS
description: Endoscopic ultrasound
source: Medicare 2024 CPT 43237: OPPS $1814.88 + physician $192.07

label: Cost EUS sampling
description: EUS sampling (FNA/FNB) incl. pathology
source: CPT 43238 vs 43237 adds $35.62 (Medicare 2024) + assumed pathology ~$115

label: Cost tumor board
description: Tumor board discussion
source: Assumed

label: Cost symptomatic diagnosis
description: Diagnostic workup when a cancer presents with symptoms
source: Assumed (EGD with biopsy + staging CT/PET)

label: First-year cost early dx
description: Treatment cost in the year of an early-stage diagnosis
source: Initial-phase cancer care cost (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: First-year cost late dx
description: Treatment cost in the year of a late-stage diagnosis
source: Stage IV stomach cancer first-year cost (Reddy et al. 2022)

label: Annual cost after early dx
description: Annual follow-up/continuing care cost after early-stage diagnosis
source: Continuing-phase cost (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: Annual cost after late dx
description: Annual continuing care cost after late-stage diagnosis
source: Assumed 3 x continuing-phase cost (ongoing systemic therapy)

label: End-of-life cost
description: Cost of terminal care at cancer death
source: Last-year-of-life cost for cancer deaths (Mariotto et al. JNCI 2026; USD 2023)

label: Cost other serious AE
description: Cost of managing a non-perforation serious adverse event (ENT, EUS, EUS sampling)
source: Assumed

label: Cost EGD perforation
description: Cost of managing an EGD perforation (admission, endoscopic stent or surgical repair)
source: Assumed; mean hospital stay 32.9 days after esophageal perforation (Biancari 2013); no US cost estimate found

label: Utility multiplier early dx
description: Utility after early-stage diagnosis as a share of age-specific baseline utility
source: Esophageal cancer EQ-5D stage I 0.66 and II/III 0.84 (Petric 2025) over US norm ~0.82 (Jiang 2021)

label: Utility multiplier late dx
description: Utility after late-stage diagnosis as a share of age-specific baseline utility
source: Esophageal cancer EQ-5D stage IV 0.67 (Petric 2025) over US norm ~0.82 (Jiang 2021)

label: QALY loss per procedure
description: QALY (and DALY) loss per diagnostic procedure (EGD/ENT/PET CT/EUS)
source: Assumed (includes anxiety while awaiting results)

label: QALY loss per serious AE
description: QALY (and DALY) loss per non-fatal serious adverse event
source: Assumed

label: Disability weight early dx
description: Disability weight while living after early-stage diagnosis (DALYs)
source: GBD 2019 cancer controlled phase 0.049 (diagnosis and primary therapy 0.288)

label: Disability weight late dx
description: Disability weight while living after late-stage diagnosis (DALYs)
source: GBD 2019 metastatic phase 0.451 (terminal 0.540)
